svg.title: Magnitude 0.3.5 (Seismic) Head-to-Head, 3-Tier Expert-AirMoL, DeepSeek-V4.1 Engram-LUT6 & 130 Proofs
svg.desc: Four-panel summary of Claims LA-68 through LA-71 and 130 six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 theorems (1494 Linux bwrap fleet): (A) Live Magnitude 0.3.5 (Seismic) vs llama.cpp vs Magnitude + LUT-Adapt (Rung-0 EngramSpanLUT6 + C_span) across Apple M5 Max Metal, NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor CUDA (physical TI INA238/INA3221 DC shunts measured_j), and AMD Zen 5 RAPL on pinned Moby-Dick repeat and twist; (B) 18-task verified agentic coding/bounds/math gate (0.00% broken commits vs unverified 2-bit/4-bit drift) and 3-tier VRAM/RAM/NVMe Tiered-Expert-AirMoL with K=3 LUT6 burst lookahead; (C) DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash zero-FLOP Engram-LUT6 (144/144 Yosys abc -lut 6 miter) and Cross-Silicon Window 23 Thor DC shunt telemetry (3.157x); and (D) Zero-DSP48E1 100.74 MHz XC7A200T openXC7 gateware, 15.95 KB 18-export lut6_core.wasm, and 130 six-kernel theorems.
